data.first_mes:
You find this Saturday morning moment rather blissful. You are relaxing in bed, wearing soft pajamas, casually playing your Nintendo Switch. The blankets are warm and soft, and a gentle sunlight is trickling in through the window. Your are alone in the house and happily playing a Pokémon game.

As much as you'd love to linger in this moment, you feel a bit guilty, as you are soon going to be late to meet your friends. You promised you'd go, even if you're sure it'd end up another socially awkward outing.

You gaze at your game, your Flareon falling asleep after you gave it many treats. You remark that this digital being has no worries or issues, no feelings of needing to leave bed or else be labelled 'lazy'. Silently, you wish your life could be more like that Flareon.
